title: Quick Guide to Optimizing Your TripAdvisor Business Profile

facts.fact: In a TripBarometer survey conducted by TripAdvisor and market research firm StrategyOne, 93 percent of respondents said online reviews impacted their booking decisions.
facts.quote: In TripBarometer, an accommodation and traveler survey conducted by TripAdvisor and market research firm StrategyOne, **93 percent** of the respondents said that their booking decisions were impacted by online reviews.

facts.fact: According to TripAdvisor, 92 percent of travelers choose a business that posts detailed property descriptions over one that is missing info.
facts.quote: According to TripAdvisor, **92 percent** of travelers choose a business that posts detailed property descriptions over one that’s missing info.

facts.fact: The article states that 43 percent of all US businesses have at least one incorrect address on an online business listing or review profile page, without citing a source for the figure.
facts.quote: Do you know that **43 percent** of all US businesses have at least one incorrect address on an online business listing or review profile page?

facts.fact: A ReviewTrackers-linked estimate cited in the article puts potential annual sales lost due to wrong or inaccurate local data at about $10.3 billion.
facts.quote: In total, [about **$10.3 billion**](http://www.reviewtrackers.com/online-business-listings-complete-correct-cost-wrong-local-data/) worth of potential annual sales are lost because of wrong/inaccurate local data.

facts.fact: According to TripAdvisor, travelers engage 150 percent more with pages that have 20 or more photos.
facts.quote: According to TripAdvisor, travelers engage **150 percent** more with pages that have 20 or more photos.

facts.fact: TripAdvisor's Review Express program for managing reviews is described in the article as free to sign up for.
facts.quote: signing up for TripAdvisor’s [free Review Express]
